data.notes: The review gets all the essentials right: the $140K ACV, the value-proof win built on her own data with no dollar figure stated, the CFO's month-end close as the real trigger, the proposal that missed the decider, Fiserv's pitch kept unknown with only the rate reply, and the opener reported as silence. It misses two smaller insights: that the named-contact request shows a weak bank relationship, and that the unproven branch card readers carry a risk into the rollout (it frames the proof gap as distributor-only).
